content.text: [Email eve@company.com → devops-team@company.com Wed Mar 07 14:00 EST 2026] Subject: [ACTION REQUIRED] GitHub Actions Breaking Changes - April 2025. Team, GitHub has announced: effective April 1, 2025, deployments:read will no longer allow reviewing/approving deployments. All workflows needing to approve/reject deployments must upgrade to deployments:write. Our deploy.yml currently uses deployments:read — this needs updating before the deadline. Reference: https://github.blog/changelog/2025-03-20-notification-of-upcoming-breaking-changes-in-github-actions/

Logged: deploy.yml must update `deployments: read` to `deployments: write` before April 1, 2025. This is a breaking change — deployments:read will no longer allow approve/reject after that date. The id-token:write permission (for OIDC) is a separate concern and must be preserved.
